brief: Continue at beginning of a loop
description: This is a special function that can be called in the body of a loop function to test the condition and, if true, start evaluating the body again. If a label is supplied, continue the loop with that label. If called outside of a loop body, an error is thrown.

parameters.description: Optional loop label. If omitted, continue the innermost loop.
parameters.name: label

returns.description: Does not complete. Continues the enclosing loop.
